description: The app repos' shared preset (each repo's renovate.json extends local>schnappy/ops//renovate/apps; task upgrade:apps:run / :check): one JDK and one Node everywhere - a repo's CI images, its Dockerfile, its mise.toml (the workstation's toolchain, a major alone: java temurin-25, node 22 - Adoptium's build numbers are not mise's) and its Gradle toolchain move together

customManagers.description: The Gradle Java toolchain - java { toolchain { languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(N) } } - read by no manager: its major alone, from Adoptium's releases (an LTS major, config:recommended's javaLTSVersions)

packageRules.description: First-party images are promoted via GitOps (task promote:run), never by Renovate
Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI is green

Every patch, minor, digest and pin of a repo (the six Dockerfiles' digest pins: their weekly group's) in ONE pull request, renovate/app-wave (operator 2026-11-23: a pull request each was a CI run, a deploy and the next one's conflict each) - the groups below take theirs back (java, node, playwright, Spring Boot's minors, the six Dockerfiles' weekly digests: each its own slug, and no rule names a branch topic, so none stays on this one's); majors their own pull request (the next rule). It merges itself only when every update in it would (a branch automerges when all its updates do): with a minor in it, merged by hand on a green CI

A repo's majors in ONE pull request of their own, renovate/major-app-majors (operator 2026-11-23: "per-repo majors group is good idea, do it") - each package's newest major alone (separateMultipleMajor's default); java, node and playwright keep theirs in their groups, Spring Boot's its own (the next rules); never merged by itself - a major that needs code changes is fixed on its branch
One JDK everywhere: the eclipse-temurin images (Dockerfiles, CI steps), mise's java and the Gradle toolchain in one pull request

Spring Boot's minors a pull request of their own, renovate/spring-boot (4.1 -> 4.2: the deprecations and removals a build meets), and its majors another (renovate/major-spring-boot) - never holding the app wave or the repo's other majors up; its patches in the wave
One Node everywhere: the node images, mise's node and @types/node (the types of the runtime's major) in one pull request - LTS (even) majors only
Playwright's browsers image and its library together - a version apart and the tests fail to start

The Gradle wrapper's checksum moved with its version (a pinned distributionSha256Sum would fail the build on the old sum): Gradle's own published sum over HTTPS - never Nexus's .sha256, which takes the zip's plain-http hop - 64 hex or nothing written; a wrapper with no distributionSha256Sum line left as it is. The version an argument, never shell text

commands: sh -c 'set -eu; s=$(curl -fsSL --proto =https "https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-$1-bin.zip.sha256"); printf %s "$s" | grep -qxE "[0-9a-f]{64}"; sed -i "s/^distributionSha256Sum=.*/distributionSha256Sum=$s/" gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties' gradle-sum {{{newVersion}}}

packageRules.description: The six services' Dockerfile base images pinned by tag AND digest (operator 2026-11-21, "do C"): every re-published base reaches an app through a reviewed, traceable pull request - not silently at its next code change. CI step images and the CI tool images stay plain tags (the decision covered these alone)

Their digest moves (and the first pins) in ONE pull request per repo, weekly: Mondays - Renovate runs by hand (ops' task upgrade:apps:run), so a run on a Monday opens or refreshes it; version-tag bumps stay their own pull requests

target-scorer: its Python minor and its locked training stack (torch, torchvision) move only with a re-lock - requirements/ci.txt is pip-compiled for one Python (3.13) and Renovate cannot regenerate it, and docker/ten.Dockerfile is the image of the training and generation runs on ten. A Python 3.15 image over the 3.13 lock: CI red, every pinned wheel refused (target-scorer#48, 2026-11-23). Their patches still move; last, so no group above takes them back
